rules.source_text: Commencing January 1, 2027, a person or entity shall not manufacture, sell, deliver, distribute, hold, or offer for sale, in commerce a food product for human consumption that contains any of the following substances: (1) Brominated vegetable oil. (2) Potassium bromate. (3) Propylparaben. (4) Red dye 3.
FDA is revoking the authorization for the use of FD&C Red No. 3 in food and ingested drugs. Manufacturers who use FD&C Red No. 3 in food have until January 15, 2027 to reformulate their products.
Manufacturers of ingested drugs have until January 18, 2028 to reformulate.
